About

Curious by nature, analytical by training

I'm an IT graduate and Digital Marketing trainee based in Accra, Ghana. My technical foundation in IT, cyber security and cloud computing shapes how I approach marketing: structured, measurable and evidence-led.

Through hands-on sales and customer support roles I learned how real buyers think — what makes them hesitate, what makes them convert, and how consistent engagement builds trust. I bring that same empathy to campaigns, pairing it with a strong analytical mindset for KPI tracking and performance reporting.

I'm continuously learning across SEO, Social Media Marketing, Content Marketing, Analytics, AI Marketing and Email Marketing — and I'm looking for a team where I can turn that curiosity into measurable business growth.

Turning analytics, KPIs and campaign reports into clear decisions.

Customer-first

Always learning
